dead_code_detector.descriptionHead: Analyzes the codebase using Knip to find unused files, dependencies, exports, and types.

error_recovery.descriptionHead: Wolverine-style self-healing: Detects errors, AI-analyzes them, auto-fixes, and retries until success.

repo_run_command.descriptionHead: Run a whitelisted repository QA command such as build, test, lint, typecheck, git diff, or git status.

repo_diff_summary.descriptionHead: Show a git status and diff summary for repository changes.
